        How it’s scored

        The three contributions add up to a maximum of 100 points.

        Correctness uses all 75 assigned questions per model. A timeout or missing tool call earns no correctness credit. Saved results are checked against archived reference SQL: duplicate counts matter, column aliases and order do not, row order matters when explicitly requested, and floating-point values are rounded to 12 significant digits.

        Cost sums saved attempts, including continuations, with provider billing preferred per attempt. Kimi’s cost is a list-price estimate. SQL speed uses mean database execution time for timed final attempts, including timeouts; it excludes model generation and missing SQL calls.

        Cost and speed are relative to this run’s best value, not absolute grades. Scores describe this 75-question sample and are not an official BIRD leaderboard.

        Efficiency charts divide saved spend, active elapsed time, and reported completion tokens by assigned tasks. Active time includes model requests and SQL execution across saved attempts, not gaps between attempts. Completion tokens include reasoning where the provider reports it as completion usage. These metrics do not change the weighted score.
